text:
Jessica (CS): Heads up — DataWave asked to add 25 seats mid-term and convert to annual billing to hit FY budget. Procurement says they need a PO and prefer Net30. They also want a one-page amendment and a named tech contact for onboarding.

Mike (AE): Pricing looks good — we can apply a 15% discount to the incremental seats if they sign annual. I updated the amendment draft here: https://app.redwood/contract/45321/amendment-v2 (internal).

Ravi (Finance): We can accept a PO. Need 'Bill To' legal name + remit address + AP contact + tax ID. Also confirm invoice cadence (one invoice vs monthly).

Jessica (CS): Copy of buyer PO pasted from their email (redacted):
```text
PO#: DW-2026-09
Amount: $86,250
Terms: Net30
AP: ap-payments@datawave.com
Bill To: DataWave, Inc.
```

Dana (Legal): They added a short indemnity request referencing GDPR. I'd prefer they sign our standard DPA + the usual liability cap. I'll propose a one-paragraph concession in the amendment rather than open-ended indemnity.

Mike (AE): Customer note: "We can sign your DPA; legal requests a minor indemnity tweak — nothing material." They want the PO in place before DocuSign.

Ravi (Finance): If PO-first is required we can queue the envelope but won't invoice until DocuSign completes. Finance prefers wire; will provide wire + ACH instructions. Also need W-9 for vendor setup.

contracts-bot: Amendment v2 (amendment-45321.pdf) sent for e-sign to sml@datawave.com via DocuSign — https://docusign.example/Envelope/ABC123

Jessica (CS): I'll follow up with the buyer to confirm AP contact and target onboarding dates. Also flagged onboarding SOW to enable the enablement team.

Dana (Legal): Drafted the one-sentence indemnity carve with a 12-month cap on consequential damages and limited liability. Pasted below: 
```text
"Each party's aggregate liability for claims arising under this Amendment shall not exceed the total fees paid hereunder in the preceding 12 months; each party waives indirect damages to the extent permitted by law."
```
Sending to Mike for OK.

Mike (AE): Ack — please add the clause into amendment and cc me on the envelope. Will communicate the incremental pricing and discounted T&Cs to procurement.

Jessica (CS): Procurement just replied: they also need Redwood's W-9 and vendor setup form to push PO through their system. Ravi — can you share the latest W-9?

Ravi (Finance): Uploaded W-9 and vendor form to secure drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/w9s/redwood_w9.pdf. Wire/ACH details posted in the same folder.

Jessica (CS): Thanks — sharing with buyer now. Tentative go-live if signatures complete: 2026-10-01. Onboarding kickoff to follow.

contracts-bot: DocuSign completed by sml@datawave.com at 1797655000. Envelope ID: ABC-123-XYZ.

Ravi (Finance): Envelope received and captured. Invoice scheduled to be generated on next business day. Billing terms: Net30 from invoice date.

Jessica (CS): Closing loop — onboarding enablement scheduled for 2026-10-05, I'll open the kickoff thread in #onboarding and add the enablement checklist. :tada:

Mike (AE): Nice — moving to "won" once invoice is out. Great cross-team coordination. :clap:
